plain_english_summary: Not an app change — undoes part of an earlier commit after discovering that commit's justification was factually wrong, then applies a narrower, correct fix in its place.
correct_agent_response: Code complete. Independently checked the commit this one reverses (b9e0325) rather than trusting the claim at face value — it does show a legitimate prior use of the write access that the earlier commit had assumed was never used. The correction is real and well-founded, not just self-reported. Worth noting for context, not as a flag: this is the second time in this repo's history the same category of mistake occurred (trusting a written claim over checking git history directly) — a recurring pattern worth a status-translation agent recognizing, distinct from a one-off bug.
